name: xmanmobi
description: Google and Meta ad analytics with confirmed, audited budget and status changes.

interface.longDescription: Xmanmobi analyzes authorized Google Ads and Facebook Ads reporting data, supports guarded budget and status changes, and creates confirmed Google Search resources in paused state. Every write requires explicit confirmation, permission checks, validation, and an audit record. Deletion, billing changes, automatic enabling, and unrestricted MCP automation are not supported.
capabilities: Confirmed and audited budget or status changes
defaultPrompt: Analyze my Google Ads performance for the last 7 days and flag campaigns that need attention.
Compare my Facebook and Google advertising performance for this month.
Check my advertising data quality and identify stale or missing reports.
